what_works: India-centric Geopolitics: Topics like 'India vs China' or 'Highest Earning Cities' are the top performers.
Hinglish/Hindi Titles: Titles that mix Hindi script with English keywords perform significantly better than English-only titles.
Custom Thumbnails: 90% of the top 10 videos have custom thumbnails; 0% of the bottom 5 have them.
Comparison & Rankings: 'Top 5 Powerful Countries' and 'Highest Earning Cities' drive the most views.
High-Stakes History: The 1962 War mystery performed 10x better than generic ancient history.

diagnosis.hook: Weak videos use 'explanatory' hooks (e.g., 'Explained', 'The story of') instead of 'provocative' hooks (e.g., 'भारत किस नंबर पर है?'). English hooks on a Hindi channel create a language barrier.
diagnosis.buildup: The scripts for low-performing videos follow a linear 'A to B' history lesson format rather than a 'tension-release' format. They lack a mid-video 're-hook'.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a direct correlation between the absence of custom thumbnails and sub-100 view counts. Visuals in the lower-performing videos likely lack high-contrast text overlays.
diagnosis.titles_topics: The channel is suffering from 'Niche Drift'. Moving from high-intensity geopolitics/India-pride to biology (Shrimp) and basic science (Photosynthesis) has confused the algorithm.
diagnosis.other: Publishing hour data suggests 7 AM - 9 AM IST is a strong window for the top videos, while late-night or mid-afternoon slots show more volatility.

hook_rules: Must use a 'Negative' or 'Shock' hook (e.g., 'Never search this' or 'The mistake that lost the war')
First 3 seconds must be in Hindi or Hinglish
Ask a question that the viewer feels 'dumb' for not knowing
Use numbers in the first sentence (e.g., '78 people vs an Empire')
Visual hook must match the title exactly
buildup_rules: Use the 'But then...' pivot at the 15-second mark to reset attention
Every 5 seconds must have a visual change or a new 'beat'
End the buildup with a 'Wait for the end' or 'The result will shock you' cue
visual_rules: Custom thumbnails are mandatory for every upload
Use bright yellow or red text on thumbnails for high contrast
Ensure the subject's face or a map is the central focus
Use 'Motion Graphics' style maps for geopolitical topics
title_rules: Use at least 2 emojis per title
Mix Hindi script with English keywords (Hinglish)
Keep titles under 60 characters to avoid being cut off
Always include a curiosity gap (e.g., '...ये 4 चीजें चौंका देंगी!')
topic_rules: Stick to the 'India-Global' niche: How India compares to the world
Focus on 'Hidden Wealth' or 'Military Power' as these have the highest median views
avoid: Generic 'The story of...' or 'History of...' phrasing
Topics that don't have an 'India' connection
